subject: Orbit Analytics — Request for supplier allowlist & PO requirement decision
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@orbitanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier intake: temporary no-PO path for 90-day pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — we’re excited to kick off the 90-day ingestion pilot next week. Our procurement team is asking whether Redwood can onboard Orbit Analytics on an invoice-only path for the pilot (no PO required), since we don’t have an established purchasing relationship yet.

Attachments: Orbit_W9.pdf, Orbit_SOW_pilot.pdf, orbit_invoice_sample.pdf

What we need from you to move forward: a short confirmation of the route (invoice-only with payment contact), the billing contact to address invoices to, and any temporary compliance checks you require. We can sign a short addendum if that helps.

ETA: can we get this approved before Nov 29 so we can start on Dec 1?

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
Orbit Analytics
procurement@orbitanalytics.com

On a related note: if there’s a standard vendor form your AP team needs, please send it over and I’ll fill it out today.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 12:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier intake: temporary no-PO path for 90-day pilot

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Looping in Priya (RevOps intake) and Marissa (Finance) to scope the controls we’ll need for a temporary invoice-only onboarding.

High level: Redwood’s standard is PO-required for vendor spend. For short-term pilots we sometimes allow an invoice-only (no-PO) path with these guardrails:
- Dollar cap for the pilot (Finance approval required)
- Signed SOW or addendum referencing Redwood’s standard MSA terms
- W9 and billing contact on file
- Payment terms confirmed (Net 30 typical)
- RevOps intake form completed for vendor allowlisting

Please confirm the pilot cap you expect (total spend across 90 days). Once Marissa confirms threshold, Priya will send the vendor intake form and the temporary addendum template.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Elena: send expected pilot spend and billing contact.
2) Priya: circulate vendor intake link + evidence checklist.
3) Marissa: confirm whether Finance can approve temporary invoice-only up to the requested cap or propose a counter cap.

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Manager, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Thanks Naomi — quick finance note. We can approve a temporary invoice-only path for pilots under the following conditions:
- Maximum pilot spend: $12,000 (cumulative)
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt
- AP requires ACH details or remittance email on first invoice
- Redwood requires a signed addendum that references our MSA and the pilot SOW; I’ve attached the temp addendum we use for invoice-only pilots.

Attachment: redwood_temp_invoice_path_addendum.pdf

If Orbit confirms spend at or below $12k and returns the signed addendum plus W9 and billing details, AP will process first invoice without a PO. Anything above $12k requires either a PO or a procurement escalation (procurement@redwood.com).

Notes for Priya: please add Orbit to the RevOps intake queue and flag as temporary invoice-only approval pending signed addendum. Priya, can you also capture the HubSpot deal id so finance can match invoices?

-Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
